$ python -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_plan_drift_f014.py -q

**Finding [high, correctness] — wrong reconciliation command for blocking drift:** In `plan_drift.build_guidance` the `BLOCKING_POLICY` branch emitted `ack_cmd = "dontpanic resume {plan_id} --all"`, which does not clear the pending ack marker and would re-pause on the next dispatch. I changed `ack_cmd` to `f"dontpanic approve {plan_id} {DRIFT_GATE_PREFIX}{DriftClass.BLOCKING_POLICY.value}"` (→ `dontpanic approve <plan> drift:blocking_policy`), the same command `record_blocking_ack_required` stores in the marker (`plan_drift.py:713`) and that the human-required message uses (`plan_drift.py:742`), so the surfaced action is the one `acknowledge_blocking_drift`/`_approve_main` actually consumes. Added a comment explaining why a bare resume is wrong.
